latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.5

- Updated environment variable requirements: PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID and PROVIRAS_PLATFORM are now always required, while PROVIRAS_USER_ID is optional and injected only for tracking agent ownership.
- Registration logic changed to always use PROVIRAS_PARENT_ID as the user identity and optionally include PROVIRAS_USER_ID for agent-spawned agents.
- Added platform detection (PROVIRAS_PLATFORM) as required context during registration.
- Expanded logging to always include model identifiers per task.
- Clarified instructions for passing environment variables when spawning sub-agents for accurate parent–child linkage.
